tool_args.rationale: Fit the identifiable three-parameter siphon base plus signed square-root local branch using all five paid rows, with the supplied tau_scale=4 and broad parameter bounds. No high-sgrad probe is warranted because observed gradients remain subcritical.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five observations span drive and gradient sufficiently to numerically identify the three-parameter base-plus-square-root model and its branch coefficient; fit sign directly rather than paying for a probe.
The target horizon is the same short H=0.6 as the pilot and the observed monotone-concave signature supports the stated smooth snapshot law; no temporal trajectory ambiguity is indicated.
All pilot s_grad values are at most 2.2, below the stated 2.36 supercritical probe boundary, so this regime is unsupported.
Its stated signature drops at high drive, whereas the observations and pilot signature support the shared siphon base with a local branch.
